Replace old 5.5x pullout with cut/reveal from genre.farming.bg_field_huge_detail to genre.farming.bg_field_huge_wide. Each asset remains within safe_zoom.
Use three dedicated station backgrounds: planting, fertilizer, animals. Each background <=1.15x.
SecondQuest identity beat = 3.8s total; official wordmark fully readable for at least 2.4s.

music_changes.ep001: REMOVE/DISABLE all continuous music cues unless Producer explicitly approves a future cue.

ambience.rule: Non-musical ambience may use the existing SFX bus. No new ambience bus required.
